Swedbank increased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 10.74% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Swedbank bought 164,305 shares as the company’s stock declined 44.72% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.69M shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $475.92 million, up from 1.53M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Swedbank who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $84.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 5.74% or $8.43 $138.51. About 28,145 shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has declined 20.90% downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.90% the S&P500.
Swedbank, which manages about $22.37 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Walt Disney Co/T (NYSE:DIS) by 37,581 shares to 1.82 million shares, valued at $212.79 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 544,119 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 5.70M shares, and cut its stake in Berkshire Hathaw (BRKB).
